name: VoxFor Mega Menu Pro
author: voxfor

sections.description:
VoxFor Mega Menu is a modern, lightweight, and fully responsive WordPress mega menu plugin designed to help you create advanced menu structures with ease. Unlike traditional menu extensions, VoxFor Mega Menu works independently of WordPress built-in menu system, offering full control via a powerful drag-and-drop builder.

Resources

  • Official Website
  • Documentation
  • Watch Full Video Guide

Key Features

  • Standalone System Works independently of WordPress menus
  • Multiple Display Methods Shortcode, PHP function, and Elementor widget support
  • Responsive Design Mobile-friendly with configurable breakpoint
  • Customization Options Color picker, animation settings, custom CSS
  • Icon Support Dashicons and Font Awesome compatibility
  • No Dependencies Lightweight codebase with minimal requirements

Display Methods

  1. Shortcode: [voxfor_mega_menu id="123"]
  2. PHP Function: <?php echo voxfor_get_mega_menu(123); ?>
  3. Elementor Widget: Available if Elementor is installed

Technical Features

  • Custom post type for mega menus
  • AJAX-powered menu builder
  • Mobile toggle and overlay system
  • CSS animation effects (fade, slide, none)
  • Touch-friendly interactions
  • Keyboard navigation support
  • RTL language support

Third Party Services

This plugin does not connect to any external services and does not track users in any way. All functionality is self-contained within your WordPress installation.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/voxfor-mega-menu/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Go to Mega Menu Dashboard to create your first menu
  4. Use the shortcode or Elementor widget to display your menu
sections.faq:
How do I create my first mega menu?

  1. Go to Mega Menu Dashboard
  2. Click “Create Your First Mega Menu”
  3. Enter a menu name and start building
  4. Copy the generated shortcode and paste it anywhere

Can I use this with any theme?

Yes, VoxFor Mega Menu is designed to work with any properly coded WordPress theme.

Is it compatible with Elementor?

Yes, the plugin includes an Elementor widget for easy integration.

Does it work on mobile devices?

Yes, the plugin is fully responsive with mobile-specific layouts and touch support.

Can I customize the styling?

Yes, you can customize colors, animations, and add custom CSS through the settings page.
